verification: Inspect continuous normal-speed motion from front, rear and a side view.
Check anatomical or mechanical pivot placement and attachments throughout the motion.
Check support loss, changing silhouette, delayed follow-through and a stable final contact pose.
For rebuilt rigs, validate the new hierarchy and skinning instead of requiring old animation bytes.
Retain numerical deformation and contact checks as necessary technical checks.
owner_feedback_20261016.approval: The agent performs technical and visual verification. No owner review gate is imposed.

hover_death_pop.finding: Hovering creatures pop down about 0.15 m on death frame 1. candidate_motions.drift() authors the hover at loc z 0.09 H, contact_rollout grounds only the death clip for hovering creatures, and ground_candidate.py re-solves Hips from frame 1, so death starts on the floor while idle floats.
hover_death_pop.affects: Every candidate grounded with ground_clips ["death"] (voidWisp, watcherEye, shade and the other floaters).
hover_death_pop.fix_direction: Death starts at the idle hover height and pose, then sinks before the first floor contact. Gate: min z >= -5 mm on every sample; [-5, +15] mm only from the first contact frame. Use a separate grounding script; ground_candidate.py stays shared and unchanged.
hover_death_pop.status: Pilot on Shade (rig-round4); port to the other floaters after its review.

observed_improvements: The lantern arm stays in front instead of sweeping over the head.
The loss of support is visible earlier from the front.
The torso curl is distributed more evenly.
The end pose has a longer, recognisable body silhouette than collapse2.
remaining_defects: The lying robe has an inflated bell-like silhouette.
The hood is obscured by the hand and its bend needs refinement.
The attached shoes form fin-like shapes at the hem in the rear view.
The reported prop floor minimum at frame 36 is -0.0058 m.
Two severe edges remain in the inner hem; the trial is not a technical pass.
measurement_limits: The mesh has boundary loops, so signed tetrahedral volume is not a reliable enclosed-volume gate.
A sleeve path measured through slice centres does not bound local edge distortion.
Reported non-death displacement is up to 0.00513 m in attack and 0.00385 m in cast; these clips are not byte-identical.
Frame inspection supports pose and shape findings; it does not establish gameplay transition quality.
